mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q01.stem: Repositioning during solder solidification has no effect on joint quality.
reasons: This statement is false. Hold the joint still and check it against criteria after cooling.
Hold the joint still and check it against criteria after cooling.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q02.stem: With 0.01 mm graduations, a thimble reading of 17 contributes 17 mm.
reasons: This statement is false. Add 17×0.01 mm.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q03.stem: A period is the time until the same state recurs in the same direction.
reasons: Choose corresponding points in the cycle correctly.
This statement is true. Choose corresponding points in the cycle correctly.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q04.stem: Do not assume zero stock at a storage location that has not been checked.
reasons: Separate verified scope from what remains unverified.
This statement is true. Separate verified scope from what remains unverified.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q05.stem: A Pareto chart only orders counts from smallest to largest and does not use cumulative percentages.
reasons: This statement is false. It helps identify the larger categories.
It helps identify the larger categories.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q06.stem: For drawings containing older symbols, check the legend and applicable standards.
reasons: Standards and revisions may differ.
This statement is true. Standards and revisions may differ.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q07.stem: Parallel branches connected between the same two points must have different voltages for different resistance values.
reasons: This statement is false. The potential difference between their endpoints is shared.
The potential difference between their endpoints is shared.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q08.stem: Both ESD protection and protection of people from electric shock must be satisfied.
reasons: ESD measures must also be compatible with safety conditions.
This statement is true. ESD measures must also be compatible with safety conditions.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q09.stem: Coils and capacitors have the same construction and are interchangeable in every circuit.
reasons: This statement is false. Their construction and properties differ.
Their construction and properties differ.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q10.stem: The term printed wiring board means there is no need to distinguish before and after component installation.
reasons: This statement is false. Make the actual production stage clear.
Make the actual production stage clear.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q11.stem: Feedback returns the detected state to compensate for the difference from a command.
reasons: Check the relationship between detection and command.
This statement is true. Check the relationship between detection and command.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q12.stem: Usable operation during a power outage depends on equipment functions and conditions.
reasons: Check functions, capacity, wiring conditions and related requirements.
This statement is true. Check functions, capacity, wiring conditions and related requirements.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q13.stem: A hex bolt’s nominal diameter may be used directly as the across-flats dimension for every tool.
reasons: This statement is false. These dimensions describe different features.
These dimensions describe different features.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q14.stem: Thermocouple measurement also depends on the reference junction, compensation leads and polarity.
reasons: Verify the consistency of the measurement system.
This statement is true. Verify the consistency of the measurement system.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q15.stem: Moving a conductor always produces sustained induced current even in an open circuit.
reasons: This statement is false. Distinguish induced voltage from current flowing in a circuit.
Distinguish induced voltage from current flowing in a circuit.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q16.stem: When work changes, reassess hazards and required training.
reasons: Check conditions appropriate to the changed work.
This statement is true. Check conditions appropriate to the changed work.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q17.stem: OSHMS means creating a plan once and never checking results after implementation.
reasons: This statement is false. It is a continuous management cycle.
It is a continuous management cycle.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q18.stem: Responding to abnormalities may include holding products, reporting and checking the affected scope.
reasons: Trace the items and scope to prevent unintended release.
This statement is true. Trace the items and scope to prevent unintended release.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q19.stem: pH has the same dimension as density and is expressed in kg/m³.
reasons: This statement is false. Do not confuse physical quantities and indicators.
Do not confuse physical quantities and indicators.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q20.stem: For exports, compare the standards required by the destination country and contract.
reasons: Check the requesting destination and differences in corresponding standards.
This statement is true. Check the requesting destination and differences in corresponding standards.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q21.stem: Every ladder-instruction symbol unconditionally equals the physical state of a real switch.
reasons: This statement is false. Distinguish input, logic and output roles.
Distinguish input, logic and output roles.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q22.stem: A thermistor is merely a zero-resistance wire under all conditions regardless of temperature.
reasons: This statement is false. Its temperature characteristics are used in its application.
Its temperature characteristics are used in its application.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q23.stem: In a sine-wave circuit containing only an ideal capacitor, current leads voltage.
reasons: Distinguish the phase relationships of ideal inductors and capacitors.
This statement is true. Distinguish the phase relationships of ideal inductors and capacitors.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q24.stem: Memory ICs and power regulators are functionally interchangeable in every application.
reasons: This statement is false. Distinguish storage from supply stabilization.
Distinguish storage from supply stabilization.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q25.stem: Pushbuttons include automatic-return and maintained-state designs.
reasons: Check the component type.
This statement is true. Check the component type.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q26.stem: Because SF6 is colorless and odorless, it may be released into the atmosphere without authorization.
reasons: This statement is false. Smell alone does not determine safety or environmental impact.
Smell alone does not determine safety or environmental impact.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q27.stem: A warehouse-method name alone does not determine acceptable PPM for every shipment.
reasons: Check scope, period and contractual conditions.
This statement is true. Check scope, period and contractual conditions.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q28.stem: LCR readings never depend on measurement frequency, so settings need not be recorded.
reasons: This statement is false. Align component and instrument conditions.
Align component and instrument conditions.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q29.stem: Reducing industrial packaging materials still requires meeting necessary protection requirements.
reasons: Do not sacrifice protection for cost alone.
This statement is true. Do not sacrifice protection for cost alone.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-theory-q30.stem: A permanent magnet’s remanence and coercivity are different properties.
reasons: Check each according to the application.
This statement is true. Check each according to the application.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q01.stem: Match a solar cell, storage battery and power conditioner to their roles.
options: All only store electricity in the same way.
Generation, storage, and DC/AC conversion or related functions.
Drawing wiring diagrams, packaging and generation.
reasons: These are not identical storage devices; they generate, store and convert respectively.
Generation, storage and conversion differ. Outage use depends on system functions and conditions.
Solar cells generate and storage batteries store; these assignments are reversed.
This confuses energy functions with drawing and packaging activities.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q02.stem: For binary inputs x=0 and y=1, what is NOT(x·y)?
reasons: This leaves the AND result unchanged and omits the outer NOT.
Binary results are zero or one, not two.
AND gives zero, and its negation is one. NOT x OR NOT y also gives one.
Applying NOT means the result is not zero like x in this case.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q03.stem: A hydraulic cylinder moves in the correct direction but slowly. Which way of organizing information is appropriate?
options: Raise pressure to maximum without authorization.
Record force, direction and speed as the same quantity.
Record flow and other speed-related factors as checks.
reasons: Unauthorized pressure increases risk exceeding ratings and do not substitute for checking flow.
Force relates to pressure, speed to flow and other factors; direction is separate information.
Flow affects speed but does not alone establish the fault location. Separate observations and verify through approved checks.
Correct direction and low speed alone do not establish a directional-valve fault.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q04.stem: Under identical conditions, defects are 12 label cases, six scratches and two missing items. What cumulative percentage is represented by the two largest categories?
reasons: 60% covers only the largest label category of 12 cases.
The two categories total 18, not 16 of 20.
18 is the count; the percentage is 18/20×100.
There are 20 cases overall and 18 in the top two, so 90%. Assess safety-critical small categories separately.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q05.stem: After assembly, leftover screws do not match the recorded count. What should you do?
options: Discard extras where they cannot be seen.
Check the remainder and inside the enclosure, and report possible missing or foreign items.
Pass them silently to the next worker.
reasons: Hiding and discarding extras obstructs reconciliation and cause investigation.
A count mismatch can indicate foreign or missing items. Reconcile actual items and records without concealing unverified conditions.
Changing records alone conceals possible missing or foreign items.
A silent handover fails to communicate the count difference or foreign-item concern.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q06.stem: Hand tapping suddenly becomes difficult. What should you do?
options: Do not force it; check pilot hole, tool, chips and other conditions under the procedure.
Remove PPE and clear chips by hand.
Add an extension pipe for more force.
reasons: Forcing increased resistance can break the tap or damage threads. Verify conditions and use the specified treatment.
Releasing the clamp lets the workpiece move, compromising accuracy and safety.
Bare-hand chip removal risks cuts and violates the specified method.
Excessive force using an extension may break the tap.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q07.stem: A small round hole needs internal hand finishing. How should the tool be selected?
options: Force the largest flat file into the hole.
Pull hard only on the return stroke.
Choose a file section and size matching the curve, while checking surfaces to retain.
Remove material without ever checking dimensions.
reasons: A large flat file does not fit the curved hole and may damage its shape.
Pulling hard against the normal cutting direction does not produce the intended cut.
Match section, size and cutting direction to the purpose; assess effects on retained geometry, not just whether it fits.
Without dimensional checks, overcutting and shape defects go undetected.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q08.stem: You want to connect PSE-marked equipment to a system with another voltage. What is appropriate?
options: PSE alone proves suitability for every voltage.
Separately verify ratings, application and connection conditions.
The marking shape grants the worker a qualification.
Removing earth always makes it usable.
reasons: PSE alone does not establish suitability for another voltage; check ratings.
PSE does not guarantee every application, voltage or work qualification.
A product marking is separate from worker qualifications.
Removing earth does not resolve voltage mismatch and undermines shock protection.
1 mm=1000 μm, so 0.25×1000=250 μm. Use consistent prefix factors.
25 μm is ten times too small.
Multiply by 1000 from mm to μm, rather than dividing.

mfg1-electrical-mock-06-practical-q10.stem: A symmetric, zero-centered waveform spans six divisions peak to trough at 2 V/div. What is its amplitude?
reasons: This doubles the 12 V peak-to-peak value, opposite to the amplitude conversion.
12 V is peak-to-peak; amplitude is half.
Half of six divisions is three, which still must be multiplied by 2 V/div.
Peak-to-peak is 6×2=12 V. Symmetry about zero makes amplitude half, 6 V.
